title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Making Payments and Managing Your Balance
summary: Explains the Business Bronze Rewards Card interest and payment rules: variable APR 20.49% on carried balances if you don’t pay your statement balance in full by the due date. Covers recurring vs one-time payments, avoiding the $32.50 late fee, and what happens if a payment is late (interest continues at 20.49%).
faqs: What interest rate applies if I carry a balance on my Business Bronze Rewards Card?
How do I set up recurring payments (statement balance vs fixed amount) and make one-time payments?
How can I avoid the late fee on my account?
If my payment is late, will I be charged $32.50 and will interest keep accruing?
What should I monitor about pending transactions before my payment clears?
What should I do to minimize additional interest after a payment becomes past due?
keywords: Recurring payments (statement balance or fixed amount)
